senses.en: a place for treating chronic illness or helping people recover their health

example.en: She spent a summer at a mountain sanatorium to recover her strength.
example.zh: 她在山间疗养院度过了一个夏天以恢复体力。

senses.en: the feeling of nausea caused by the movement of a boat

example.en: The rough waves gave several passengers seasickness.
example.zh: 汹涌的波浪让几名乘客晕船了。

senses.en: to bring a people or place to a more advanced or orderly way of life

example.en: The program aimed to civilise the rough mining town.
example.zh: 该项目旨在让这个粗野的矿业小镇变得文明开化。

senses.en: to teach someone better manners or more refined behaviour

example.en: Spending weekends at his aunt's helped civilise the boy.
example.zh: 周末在姨妈家度日让这男孩变得有教养了。

senses.en: the study or use of symbols and symbolism

example.en: The book examines the symbology of ancient coins.
example.zh: 这本书探讨了古代钱币上的符号象征。

senses.en: used as a temporary substitute for something better

example.en: They slept on a makeshift bed made of chairs.
example.zh: 他们睡在用椅子拼成的临时床铺上。

senses.en: something used temporarily until a proper thing is available

example.en: The tarpaulin was only a makeshift until the roof could be repaired.
example.zh: 油布只是屋顶修好前的临时代用品。

senses.en: the district under the authority of a bishop

example.en: The new bishop was assigned to a large rural diocese.
example.zh: 新主教被派往一个大的乡村教区。

senses.en: a period when lights or power go out over an area

example.en: A storm caused a blackout across the whole city.
example.zh: 一场风暴导致全城停电。

senses.en: a temporary loss of consciousness or memory
senses.zh: 暂时失去知觉；记忆中断

example.en: He had a brief blackout after standing up too quickly.
example.zh: 他起立过猛后短暂失去了知觉。

senses.en: the banning of broadcasting or reporting of an event

example.en: The match was subject to a television blackout.
example.zh: 这场比赛被电视停播。

senses.en: a tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells
senses.zh: 在活细胞内繁殖的微小传染性病原体

example.en: The virus spreads through close contact.
example.zh: 这种病毒通过密切接触传播。

senses.en: a program that copies itself and can damage computers or files
senses.zh: 能自我复制并可能损坏计算机或文件的程序

example.en: A computer virus can damage files and slow down a system.
example.zh: 计算机病毒会损坏文件并拖慢系统。

senses.en: a common chemical element found in all living things and in forms such as diamond and graphite

example.en: Diamonds and graphite are both forms of carbon.
example.zh: 钻石和石墨都是碳的形式。

senses.en: a copy of a document or message sent to someone else

example.en: She sent a carbon copy of the letter to her lawyer.
example.zh: 她把信的副本寄给了她的律师。

senses.en: thin paper coated with a dark substance, used to make copies of typed or written material

example.en: The receipt was typed using carbon paper.
example.zh: 收据是用复写纸打出来的。

senses.en: a series of musical notes that is pleasant or easy to remember; a melody

example.en: She hummed a cheerful tune as she walked home.
example.zh: 她走在回家的路上，哼着一支欢快的曲子。

senses.en: to adjust a musical instrument so that it produces the correct notes

example.en: The musician tuned the violin before the concert.
example.zh: 音乐家在音乐会前给小提琴调了音。

senses.en: to adjust a machine or system to make it work better

example.en: The mechanic tuned the engine to improve its performance.
example.zh: 机械师调整了发动机以提高其性能。

senses.en: what you plan or aim to do; purpose

example.en: Her intent was to help, not to cause trouble.
example.zh: 她的意图是帮忙，而不是惹麻烦。

senses.en: showing strong and careful attention

example.en: He listened with an intent expression.
example.zh: 他神情专注地听着。

senses.en: a close connection between people, especially an emotional one

example.en: She has a close relationship with her older sister.
example.zh: 她和姐姐关系亲密。

senses.en: a connection or link between things or events

example.en: The study found a relationship between sleep and mood.
example.zh: 研究发现睡眠与情绪之间存在关联。

senses.en: a romantic partnership between two people

example.en: They are in a romantic relationship.
example.zh: 他们处于恋爱关系中。

senses.en: the highest part or upper surface of something

example.en: The cat sat on top of the cupboard.
example.zh: 猫坐在柜子顶上。

senses.en: highest in position, rank, or importance

example.en: She reached the top floor by stairs.
example.zh: 她走楼梯到了顶层。

senses.en: to be higher or greater than something

example.en: His latest song topped the charts for three weeks.
example.zh: 他的最新歌曲连续三周位居排行榜榜首。

senses.en: the act of controlling or organizing something

example.en: Good management of resources is important.
example.zh: 良好的资源管理很重要。

senses.en: the people who are in charge of running a business or organization

example.en: The management approved the new plan.
example.zh: 管理层批准了新计划。

senses.en: relating to Germany, its people, or its language
senses.zh: 德国的；德国人的；德语的

example.en: He enjoys German literature.
example.zh: 他喜欢德国文学。

senses.en: a person from Germany

example.en: She is a German living in Canada.
example.zh: 她是居住在加拿大的德国人。

senses.en: the language spoken in Germany and several other countries

example.en: I am learning German.
example.zh: 我正在学习德语。

senses.en: an enclosed armored military vehicle with a cannon and caterpillar treads

example.en: The tank rolled slowly across the field.
example.zh: 坦克缓缓驶过田野。

senses.en: a large container for holding liquids or gases

example.en: We filled the water tank before the trip.
example.zh: 出发前我们把水箱装满了。

senses.en: to fail badly or decrease sharply

example.en: The film tanked at the box office.
example.zh: 这部电影票房惨败。

senses.en: existing in large amounts; abundant

example.en: Fresh vegetables are plentiful at the market in summer.
example.zh: 夏天市场上的新鲜蔬菜很充足。

senses.en: funny; full of humor

example.en: She told a humorous story that made everyone laugh.
example.zh: 她讲了一个幽默的故事，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

senses.en: the act or manner of using something, especially to good effect

example.en: The company is trying to improve the utilization of its resources.
example.zh: 这家公司正设法提高其资源的利用率。

senses.en: difficult or impossible to reach or enter
senses.zh: 难以到达的；无法进入的

example.en: The village is inaccessible in winter because of heavy snow.
example.zh: 这个村庄冬天因大雪而难以进入。

senses.en: difficult or impossible to obtain or use
senses.zh: 难以获得的；无法使用的

example.en: Medical care remains inaccessible to many people in remote areas.
example.zh: 偏远地区的许多人仍然难以获得医疗服务。

senses.en: the process by which a liquid changes into vapor

example.en: Evaporation happens faster on hot, windy days.
example.zh: 炎热有风的天气里蒸发得更快。

senses.en: gradual disappearance

example.en: The evaporation of public confidence worried the government.
example.zh: 公众信心的消失令政府担忧。

senses.en: a person paid to persuade politicians to support certain policies

example.en: The lobbyist met with lawmakers to discuss the new bill.
example.zh: 这位说客与议员们会面，讨论新法案。

senses.en: relating to ideas or concepts rather than concrete things

example.en: The plan is still at a conceptual stage.
example.zh: 该计划仍处于概念阶段。

senses.en: completely or extremely; in a way that affects the basic nature of something

example.en: The internet has radically changed how people communicate.
example.zh: 互联网从根本上改变了人们的交流方式。

senses.en: relating to being a mother, or typical of a mother

example.en: She showed a maternal instinct toward the children.
example.zh: 她对这些孩子表现出母性的本能。

senses.en: relating to or coming from one's mother's side of the family

example.en: My maternal grandmother lives in another city.
example.zh: 我的外祖母住在另一个城市。

senses.en: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds

example.en: The bus leaves in five minutes.
example.zh: 公共汽车五分钟后出发。

senses.en: a very short time; a moment

example.en: Can I talk to you for a minute?
example.zh: 我能和你谈一会儿吗？

senses.en: the written record of a meeting

example.en: She took the minutes at the staff meeting.
example.zh: 她在员工会议上做会议记录。

senses.en: extremely small

example.en: There is a minute difference between the two samples.
example.zh: 两个样本之间有极小的差异。

senses.en: on some occasions, but not always

example.en: I sometimes walk to work instead of taking the bus.
example.zh: 我有时步行去上班，不坐公交。

senses.en: no longer alive

example.en: The old man was found dead in his room.
example.zh: 老人被发现死在房间里。

senses.en: not working, active, or full of life; lacking energy
senses.zh: 无生命的；失去功能的；无生气的

example.en: The phone battery is completely dead.
example.zh: 手机电池彻底没电了。

senses.en: people who are no longer living

example.en: A monument was built in memory of the dead.
example.zh: 人们建了一座纪念碑来纪念死者。

senses.en: completely; exactly (informal)

example.en: The car stopped dead in the middle of the road.
example.zh: 汽车在路中间突然停住不动了。

senses.en: to greet someone arriving in a friendly way

example.en: They welcomed the guests at the door.
example.zh: 他们在门口迎接客人。

senses.en: pleasing and gladly received; allowed to do something

example.en: You are welcome to stay for dinner.
example.zh: 你可以随意留下来吃晚饭。

senses.en: a friendly greeting or reception given to someone

example.en: She gave us a warm welcome.
example.zh: 她热情地欢迎了我们。

senses.en: a friendly greeting to someone arriving

example.en: Welcome! Please come in.
example.zh: 欢迎！请进。

senses.en: paying close attention so as to avoid mistakes or harm

example.en: She read the contract carefully before signing it.
example.zh: 她签字前仔细阅读了合同。

senses.en: in a cautious way, avoiding risk or damage

example.en: He carried the fragile vase carefully upstairs.
example.zh: 他小心翼翼地把易碎的花瓶搬上楼。

senses.en: a tree or shrub with large, fragrant white or pink flowers

example.en: A magnolia tree blooms in front of the house every spring.
example.zh: 每年春天房前都有一棵木兰开花。

senses.en: expressed clearly and in few words

example.en: She gave a succinct summary of the report.
example.zh: 她对该报告作了简明的总结。

senses.en: enjoying the company of other people; friendly

example.en: She is sociable and makes friends easily.
example.zh: 她好交际，容易交到朋友。

senses.en: not real; existing only in the imagination

example.en: The scenery looked so perfect it seemed unreal.
example.zh: 那景色美得不真实。

senses.en: (informal) amazing or incredible in a good way

example.en: The atmosphere at the concert was completely unreal.
example.zh: 音乐会上的气氛真是太棒了。

senses.en: a case, usually leather, for carrying a handgun on the body
senses.zh: 手枪皮套；（放工具的）皮带套

example.en: He drew the pistol quickly from his holster.
example.zh: 他迅速从枪套里拔出手枪。

senses.en: to put a gun or weapon into its holster

example.en: He holstered his gun and left the room.
example.zh: 他把手枪放入枪套，离开了房间。

senses.en: the back part or rear side of something

example.en: The label is printed on the backside of the package.
example.zh: 标签印在包装的背面。

senses.en: (informal) the part of the body you sit on; buttocks

example.en: He slipped and landed on his backside.
example.zh: 他滑倒了，摔在了屁股上。

senses.en: a short clever or witty remark

example.en: She ended the speech with a quip that made everyone laugh.
example.zh: 她以一句让所有人发笑的妙语结束了演讲。

senses.en: to make witty remarks

example.en: 'Better late than never,' he quipped.
example.zh: 他打趣道：“迟到总比不到好。”

senses.en: behaving badly and not willing to follow rules or advice

example.en: Her wayward son often skipped school.
example.zh: 她任性的儿子经常逃学。

senses.en: to listen secretly to other people's conversation

example.en: He was eavesdropping on their conversation.
example.zh: 他在偷听他们的谈话。

senses.en: having or using complete power without allowing others to influence decisions

example.en: The manager had an autocratic style of leadership.
example.zh: 这位经理的领导风格很专断。

senses.en: a small European bird with an orange-red breast, or a larger North American bird with a reddish breast

example.en: A robin landed on the garden fence.
example.zh: 一只知更鸟落在花园的篱笆上。

senses.en: done at random, without distinguishing between people or things

example.en: The storm caused indiscriminate damage across the region.
example.zh: 风暴给整个地区造成了不加区分的破坏。

senses.en: not careful or selective in choice

example.en: He is indiscriminate in his choice of friends.
example.zh: 他交朋友不加选择。

senses.en: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong taste, used in cooking
senses.zh: 洋葱，一种圆形、多层的蔬菜，味道浓烈，常用于烹饪

example.en: She chopped an onion for the soup.
example.zh: 她切了一个洋葱做汤。

senses.en: an address used to locate a resource, such as a web page or file; usually written URL

example.en: Copy the URL and paste it into your browser.
example.zh: 复制这个网址并粘贴到浏览器中。

senses.en: the daughter of your son or daughter
senses.zh: 儿子或女儿的女儿；孙女或外孙女

example.en: Their granddaughter visits them every Sunday.
example.zh: 他们的孙女每周日都来看望他们。

senses.en: a piece of land completely surrounded by water

example.en: The small island has no cars.
example.zh: 这座小岛没有汽车。

senses.en: a raised or separate area used for a particular purpose, such as in a kitchen or road
senses.zh: （厨房的）中岛台；（道路的）安全岛

example.en: She chopped vegetables at the kitchen island.
example.zh: 她在厨房中岛台上切菜。

senses.en: belonging to or connected with someone or something

example.en: She is a friend of my brother.
example.zh: 她是我哥哥的朋友。

senses.en: used to show what something contains, consists of, or is made from

example.en: He drank a cup of tea.
example.zh: 他喝了一杯茶。

senses.en: about or concerning someone or something

example.en: We talked of moving abroad.
example.zh: 我们谈到移居国外。

senses.en: used to show cause or source

example.en: He died of cancer.
example.zh: 他死于癌症。

senses.en: a long piece of research writing done for a university degree

example.en: She spent two years writing her master's thesis on climate change.
example.zh: 她花了两年时间撰写关于气候变化的硕士论文。

senses.en: a statement or claim that you argue to be true, especially as the main idea of an essay or speech

example.en: The essay's central thesis is that technology changes how we remember.
example.zh: 这篇文章的核心论点是技术改变了我们的记忆方式。

senses.en: a condition that makes success or progress harder

example.en: His lack of experience is a big disadvantage in the job market.
example.zh: 缺乏经验是他在就业市场上的一大劣势。

senses.en: a flaw or drawback of something

example.en: The main disadvantage of living in the city is the high cost of housing.
example.zh: 住在城市的主要缺点是住房成本高。

senses.en: to put someone in an unfavorable position

example.en: Rising prices disadvantage families on low incomes.
example.zh: 物价上涨使低收入家庭处于不利地位。

senses.en: very bright light that hurts your eyes

example.en: The glare of the sun made it hard to see the road.
example.zh: 刺眼的阳光让人很难看清道路。

collocations: in the glare of the sun

senses.en: to stare angrily at someone

example.en: She glared at her brother when he took her phone.
example.zh: 弟弟拿走她的手机时，她怒视着他。

senses.en: an angry look

example.en: He gave me an angry glare and walked away.
example.zh: 他愤怒地瞪了我一眼，然后走开了。

senses.en: a woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried

example.en: She became a widow at the age of forty.
example.zh: 她四十岁时成了寡妇。

senses.en: to make someone a widow or widower by taking away their spouse

example.en: The war widowed thousands of women.
example.zh: 战争使成千上万的妇女丧偶。

senses.en: a fixed, oversimplified idea about a type of person or thing

example.en: It's unfair to judge people based on a stereotype.
example.zh: 根据刻板印象来评判人是不公平的。

senses.en: to form or show a fixed, oversimplified idea of a person or group
senses.zh: 对……形成刻板印象；把……刻板化地看待或描绘

example.en: The film stereotypes people from that region.
example.zh: 这部电影把那个地区的人刻画得千篇一律。

senses.en: to combine or join together into one

example.en: The two companies plan to merge next year.
example.zh: 这两家公司计划明年合并。

senses.en: to blend or fade gradually into something else

example.en: The road merges with the highway ahead.
example.zh: 这条道路在前方汇入高速公路。

senses.en: to officially order someone to come, e.g. to court or a meeting

example.en: The court summoned him to appear as a witness.
example.zh: 法院传唤他出庭作证。

senses.en: to call for or send for someone

example.en: She summoned a waiter to take their order.
example.zh: 她叫来一名服务员点单。

senses.en: to try hard to bring up a feeling or quality

example.en: He summoned the courage to speak in public.
example.zh: 他鼓起勇气当众发言。

senses.en: completely disordered and confusing, with no organization

example.en: Traffic in the city center is chaotic during rush hour.
example.zh: 高峰时段市中心的交通一片混乱。

senses.en: shining with a soft warm light
senses.zh: 发微光的；炽热的；色彩鲜艳的

example.en: The room was lit by the glowing embers of the fire.
example.zh: 房间里被火炉中发亮的余烬照着。

senses.en: full of praise or enthusiasm

example.en: The film received glowing reviews.
example.zh: 这部电影获得了盛赞的评价。

senses.en: a person who does not eat meat or fish

example.en: As a vegetarian, she orders vegetable dishes instead of meat.
example.zh: 作为素食者，她点蔬菜类菜品而不是肉。

senses.en: containing no meat or fish

example.en: The restaurant offers several vegetarian options on its menu.
example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜单上有几道素菜可选。

senses.en: an unlucky event or accident, often one causing harm

example.en: He died by misadventure, the inquest concluded.
example.zh: 调查结论认为他死于意外事故。

senses.en: a large brown seaweed that grows in the ocean

example.en: Kelp forests provide shelter for many sea creatures.
example.zh: 海藻林为许多海洋生物提供庇护。

senses.en: showing mild confusion or puzzlement, often with a raised eyebrow

example.en: She gave him a quizzical look when he mentioned the plan.
example.zh: 当他提到这个计划时，她用疑惑的眼神看了看他。

senses.en: playfully teasing or mocking

example.en: He answered with a quizzical smile.
example.zh: 他带着戏谑的微笑回答。

senses.en: acting morally superior in a way that seems insincere or hypocritical

example.en: His sanctimonious speeches annoyed everyone at the meeting.
example.zh: 他那些假惺惺的发言让会上所有人反感。

senses.en: having a thin, high sound like that of a reed instrument

example.en: His voice sounded reedy over the old microphone.
example.zh: 在旧麦克风里，他的声音听起来尖细发飘。

senses.en: full of or resembling reeds; tall and thin

example.en: Reeds grew thickly along the reedy riverbank.
example.zh: 芦苇茂密地长在这长满芦苇的河岸边。

senses.en: able to see distant objects clearly

example.en: Farsighted people often need glasses for reading.
example.zh: 远视的人看书时常常需要戴眼镜。

senses.en: planning wisely for the future

example.en: Her farsighted investments protected the company during the crisis.
example.zh: 她有远见的投资使公司在危机中得到了保护。

senses.en: to give someone or something a higher, more dignified quality

example.en: Suffering can ennoble a person's character.
example.zh: 苦难可以使人品格变得高尚。

senses.en: to give someone a noble title

example.en: The king ennobled his most loyal advisor.
example.zh: 国王封他最忠实的顾问为贵族。

senses.en: high up in the air; overhead

example.en: The balloon floated aloft above the field.
example.zh: 气球高高地飘浮在田野上空。

senses.en: the highest point or level of success or achievement

example.en: Winning the championship was the pinnacle of his career.
example.zh: 赢得冠军是他职业生涯的巅峰。

senses.en: a tall pointed piece of stone on top of a building or rock

example.en: Stone pinnacles decorated the corners of the tower.
example.zh: 石制小尖塔装饰着塔楼的四角。

senses.en: relating to climate

example.en: Scientists study climatic changes in the region.
example.zh: 科学家研究该地区的气候变化。

senses.en: to argue about small unimportant things

example.en: The couple kept bickering about whose turn it was to cook.
example.zh: 这对夫妻一直在为该轮到谁做饭而斗嘴。

senses.en: a petty quarrel

example.en: Their bicker over the TV remote lasted ten minutes.
example.zh: 他们为电视遥控器吵了十分钟。

senses.en: able to be noticed, discovered, or measured

example.en: There was no detectable difference between the two samples.
example.zh: 两个样本之间没有可检测到的差异。

senses.en: to make things happen or work at exactly the same time or speed

example.en: You can synchronize the subtitles with the video.
example.zh: 你可以让字幕和视频同步。

senses.en: to happen at the same time

example.en: The flashing lights synchronized with the beat of the music.
example.zh: 闪烁的灯光与音乐节奏同步了。

senses.en: to scold or criticize someone angrily and at length

example.en: The coach berated the players for their careless mistakes.
example.zh: 教练因为队员们粗心的失误而痛斥了他们。

senses.en: movable barriers that close the entrances to buildings, rooms, or vehicles

example.en: She opened both doors to let fresh air into the house.
example.zh: 她打开两扇门让新鲜空气进入屋子。

senses.en: entrances or ways of getting into something

example.en: The training program opens doors to better jobs.
example.zh: 这个培训项目为获得更好的工作打开了大门。

senses.en: an instrument with a rotating drum that records continuous traces of physiological processes
senses.zh: 记波器；波动曲线记录仪

example.en: The lab used a kymograph to record muscle contractions.
example.zh: 实验室用记波器记录肌肉收缩。

senses.en: money that a person keeps or puts aside instead of spending

example.en: She used her savings to buy a car.
example.zh: 她用积蓄买了一辆车。
